text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shortly before the Wakagoma Stakes. "It" 
happened during a mock race.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(It's almost—start time. Still, I really 
don't like being inside the gate...)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(I feel like a captive trapped in a 
dungeon... Grrrgh...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crash!)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Whoa!? Crap—!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: WOOOOH, wait wait wait up!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... Second place... To 
think I'd slip up against this field...
choice_data_list:
Haven't your starts been getting worse 
lately?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I am... aware of it. I've been 
holding back ever since my Junior year, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's far too cramped here for me to 
concentrate...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Her race management itself is improving, 
but starting off like this undermines the 
entire foundation of the race.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Is there any countermeasure...?
choice_data_list: Hmm... how about changing your mindset?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ...Consciousness?
choice_data_list:
Yeah... What if you thought of the 
starting gate as your own private room?

Yeah... Maybe try thinking of the gate as 
your own private room?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Private room... Like a private booth at 
an internet cafe...?"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, that place is super comfy. 
All-you-can-play games, unlimited manga, 
and free soft serve too~~~.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I see. If we consider that they are not 
trapped, but secluding themselves 
willingly...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's go with that mental image 
for the next practice race.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Don't get agitated…… This is a private 
booth in a net cafe…… A private booth……

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Haaah... So relaxing...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crash!)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: I relaxed WAY too much~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, the problem was never resolved 
right up until the day of the Wakagoma 
Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I understand. I'll be very 
careful, but...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, I totally hate going 
outside~~~. I just can't deal with that 
part, y'know...
choice_data_list: Do your best, for the future too!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Stumbling right at the first goal of 
the Classic year would hurt way too 
much...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's the first move. I must nail the 
opening move no matter what. Alright—just 
watch me.
